Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner already had enough evidence by Step 4 that Mikhail Gorbachev initiated the State of the World Forum, an international dialogue forum. Instead of synthesizing this into a clear “type of forum” answer, the Planner kept looping through similar WebSurfer searches, leaning on vague promotional phrasing (e.g., “join visionary organizations”) and purpose statements. This led to misreporting the forum type as a generic purpose (“organizations could come together to address global issues”) rather than the correct type (an international dialogue forum/State of the World Forum).
